question.question_text: After the camera wearer inspects the laptop thoroughly, _________ happens before he works with the disc slot.

answer_options.text: Covers it with the laptop's cover
Adjusts the camera on his head
Installs the motherboard into the base enclosure

shared_investigation.established_facts: The camera wearer holds and examines a phone with both hands while looking at the screen. The camera wearer then disassembles the laptop, holding the motherboard, placing it on a table, using a screwdriver to remove screws, handling various components like memory card, cables, hard drive, and repositioning the laptop. The camera wearer continues to hold the laptop with both hands, removes the hard drive, cooling fan, and screws using a screwdriver, and handles the laptop back cover and CD drive. The camera wearer places components on the table and eventually places the laptop on his lap.

evidence_index.source_content: Disassembly of laptop: holding motherboard, placing on table, using screwdriver to remove screws, handling various components (memory card, cables, hard drive), picking up and repositioning the laptop.
Continued laptop disassembly and component removal: removing hard drive, cooling fan, screws using screwdriver, handling motherboard and back cover, placing components on table.

Final disassembly steps and repositioning: walking around room, picking up screwdriver, using mouse/computer, removing screws from hard drive, handling laptop back cover and CD drive, placing laptop on lap.
